title: Unanswered Check
summary: Lists blank, partial and flagged questions before a test or survey is submitted, with jump links and time left.
description: Pre-submit check for tests and surveys: required and optional blanks, partly answered and flagged questions as numbered jump links, time left and per-question pace, a second click for blanks, a hard stop for required survey questions and a submit that waits for saves.
catches: Required and optional questions left blank
Answers not yet saved to the server
Time left and how much each open question gets
limits: Only knows the question states you pass
Time limits and auto-submit rely on your onTimeUp and server timing
a11y: Section labelled by its heading; countdown is role=timer with an aria-label
Jump links have aria-labels including notes
Status in a polite live region; errors use role=alert
server: Enforce required answers and the deadline on the server; accept submissions only once all answers are saved.
